meta.name: The Married Woman
meta.description:
A wife, a mom, a teacher, a homemaker, she's played all the roles, but what about being true to herself? Being Astha? Be a part of Astha's journey as she breaks boundaries, set by society, to find herself.

Ended · First aired 8 Mar 2021 · India · Language: Hindi · 32 min
Studio: Juggernaut Productions, In10 Network, ALTBalaji · Network: ALTBalaji, ZEE5

Complete series. On your server: S1 11/11

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Blurred Lines
videos.overview: Astha and Aijaz meet each other under very uncomfortable circumstances. They are gradually growing fond of each other. Vandals arrive at the theatre to threaten Aijaz.

videos.title: Line Ke Uss Paar
videos.overview: Aijaz Gifts Astha a book of poems. She falls deeper for Aijaz. Aijaz and Astha decide to attend the play going against the circumstances, she pays a visit to Aijaz after the play.

videos.title: Kya Khoya Kya Paaya
videos.overview: Astha is still trying to cope with loss of Aijaz, Timsi wishes to speak to Astha. Timsi and Mudassar eloped and got married in a temple. Peeplika and Astha share a moment.

videos.title: Mulaqat Khud Se
videos.overview: The newly wedded couple have come to meet Timsi’s family. Aastha asks Peeplika to help sort the situation. The two families have accepted the wedding. Aastha consoles an emotional Peeplika.

videos.title: Sahi Galat Ke Beech
videos.overview: Astha is confused about her feelings. Peeplika confronts Astha about her emotions but she denies herself. Everybody is busy preparing for Timsi and Mudassar’s wedding.

videos.title: Dil-e-naadaan, Tujhe Hua Kya Hai?
videos.overview: Babbo is suspicious of Astha’s friendship with Peeplika. Peeplika tells Astha about her past. Babbo takes Astha out for shopping, but Astha makes an excuse and goes to meet Peeplika’s mother.

videos.title: Ishq Aur Mushq
videos.overview: Astha makes an excuse to visit Peeplika during the curfew. Peeplika invites Astha to join her for relief camp. Hemant finds out that Astha had lied to him about her plans.

videos.title: Half Full Half Empty
videos.overview: Peeplika drops Astha home coming back from the relief camp. Peeplika wants Astha to meet her friends. Hemant follows Astha after college suspecting her of debauchery.

videos.title: The Wedding Anniversary
videos.overview: Astha’s mom has come to celebrate Hemant and Astha’s 11th Anniversary. She gives Astha a piece of her mind. Peeplika shows up at the anniversary celebration.

videos.title: New Horizons
videos.overview: Peeplika offers Astha to move to Paris with her. Hemant confronts Astha about her relationship with Peeplika. Astha ends up deciding to leave with Peeplika.

videos.title: Crossroads
videos.overview: Astha is silently bidding goodbye to her kids. Indira arrives at Peeplika’s and tells Astha about Peeplika’s untold past. Astha confronts Peeplika about her discoveries. Astha makes her final decision.
